description: Анализ метрик синхронизации: avg, min, max, RMS по master и slave узлам

targets.rawSql:
WITH last_before AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.hostname, e.port)
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time,
    n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
    e.to_state
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
  JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
  WHERE e.time < $__timeFrom()
    AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
    AND e.port > 0
  ORDER BY n.hostname, e.port, e.time DESC
)
SELECT
  e.time,
  n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
  e.to_state
FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time)
  AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
  AND e.port > 0

UNION ALL

SELECT time, series, to_state FROM last_before

ORDER BY time, series

SELECT
  hostname,
  type::text AS type,
  interface,
  adapter_name
FROM timesync.nodes
WHERE hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
ORDER BY type, hostname

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname AS metric,
  avg(offset_ns) AS "Offset (ns)"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${phc2sys_node_type}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT node_id, MAX(time) AS max_time
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'
    GROUP BY node_id
)
SELECT
    n.hostname               AS hostname,
    m.window_size_s::numeric AS window_size_s,
    m.mtie_ns                AS ns
FROM timesync.quality_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
JOIN latest l ON m.node_id = l.node_id AND m.time = l.max_time
WHERE m.sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'

UNION ALL

-- G.8273.2 dTEL MTIE mask (constant temp, τ ≤ 1000s): Class B = 40 ns, Class C = 10 ns, Class D = 5 ns
SELECT
    unnest(ARRAY['G.8273.2 Class B (40 ns)', 'G.8273.2 Class C (10 ns)', 'G.8273.2 Class D (5 ns)']) AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                                                         AS window_size_s,
    unnest(ARRAY[40.0, 10.0, 5.0])                                                                   AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'
) w

ORDER BY hostname, window_size_s

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT node_id, MAX(time) AS max_time
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'
    GROUP BY node_id
)
-- Кривые нод
SELECT
    n.hostname               AS hostname,

    m.tdev_ns                AS ns
FROM timesync.quality_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id

UNION ALL

-- G.8272 PRTC MTIE masks: (0.275·τ + 25) ns, clamped at 100 ns (PRTC-A) or 40 ns (PRTC-B)
SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC-A (100 ns)'                                           AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,
    LEAST(0.275 * w.window_size_s::numeric + 25.0, 100.0)::float8       AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'pps'
) w

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC-B (40 ns)'                                            AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,
    LEAST(0.275 * w.window_size_s::numeric + 25.0, 40.0)::float8        AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'pps'
) w

ORDER BY hostname, window_size_s

-- G.8272 PRTC TDEV mask (piecewise):
--   τ < 100 s  -> 3 ns
--   100 ≤ τ < 1000 s -> 0.03·τ ns
--   τ ≥ 1000 s -> 30 ns
SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC'                                                      AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,
    CASE
        WHEN w.window_size_s < 100  THEN 3.0
        WHEN w.window_size_s < 1000 THEN 0.03 * w.window_size_s::numeric
        ELSE 30.0
    END::float8                                                         AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'pps'
) w

ORDER BY hostname, window_size_s

FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${ptp4l_node_type}'

WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${ptp4l_node_type}'

WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${phc2sys_node_type}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname || ' pps' AS metric,

FROM timesync.pps_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id

GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH ptp AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  ptp.t AS time,
  n.hostname AS metric,
  ptp.offset - pps.offset AS "ptp4l - PPS (ns)"
FROM ptp
JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = ptp.node_id AND pps.t = ptp.t
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = ptp.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${ptp4l_node_type}'
ORDER BY 1

WITH phc AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  phc.t AS time,
  n.hostname AS metric,
  phc.offset - pps.offset AS "phc2sys - PPS (ns)"
FROM phc
JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = phc.node_id AND pps.t = phc.t
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = phc.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${phc2sys_node_type}'
ORDER BY 1

WITH phc AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
diff AS (
  SELECT phc.node_id, phc.offset - pps.offset AS delta
  FROM phc JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = phc.node_id AND pps.t = phc.t
)
SELECT
  n.hostname,
  n.type::text AS type,
  round(avg(abs(delta))) AS "Avg abs",
  min(delta) AS "Min",
  max(delta) AS "Max",
  round(sqrt(avg(power(delta::float8, 2)))) AS "RMS"
FROM diff
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = diff.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY n.hostname, n.type
ORDER BY n.type, n.hostname
